learning.title: Record the lane CI runs, not the test file you happened to name
learning.trigger: A green evidence table lists only the test file the author chose, and CI fails afterwards in a shard that imports the changed type or stylesheet.
learning.rule: Changing a shared interface or a shared stylesheet obliges the whole lane: pnpm test:unit for anything a component type reaches (a new method on BakeryApiClient broke two hand-built stubs in tests/unit), and pnpm test:rails for CSS and catalogue work (the UI css rail scans comments, so a ticket reference written as a hash plus digits reads as a raw hex colour and fails backend rails). pnpm test:rails needs packages/ui/storybook-static, so run pnpm --filter @bakery/ui build-storybook first in a fresh worktree or five rails tests fail with NotFound rather than a real defect. Put each lane in the evidence table as its own row so the table disagrees with the author who skips one.

verification.requirement: A frozen element cited by the evidence must be the assertion the finding predicts, never a weaker one.
